title: Investor Reliance on ESG Ratings and Stock Price Performance
authors: Aleksandra Rzeźnik; Kathleen Weiss Hanley; Loriana Pelizzon
eligible_reason: Single event (Morningstar/Sustainalytics switch to ESG Risk Ratings, Oct 2019): event = 1 for Oct-Dec 2019 vs 0 for Jul-Sep 2019 for every stock (DynamicDiD.do lines 11-15), interacted with the continuous standardized rating change (zdif_esg, decompositions zdif_invert_esg / zdif_unmeasured / zdif_sustainalytics). reghdfe sabnret c.zdif_esg##i.event, absorb(PERMNO [industry x event]). Continuous treatment and one date; the 2018 placebo sample is likewise single-date. No staggered binary design.
design_notes: Two-period stock panel around the rating methodology change; outcomes are abnormal returns, fund/13F/retail (Robinhood) ownership changes, short interest; cross-sectional regressions of ownership changes on rating changes; dynamic monthly version interacts rating change with month dummies.
data_files_note: ReadMe.pdf: 'All variables have been randomized, and all identifiers and dates are made up. The mock datasets will not reproduce the results in the paper.' Real Morningstar/Sustainalytics/CRSP/13F/IHS Markit data not shipped; logs from the actual data included.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Continuous rating change at one date; mock data only.
